channel.title: The Grant Desk - Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 27 Jul 2026 (27 Jul to 02 Aug 2026).

  • Creative Residency at Bloedel Reserve: Class of 2027
    https://bloedelreserve.slideroom.com/#/login/program/88209
    Bloedel Reserve · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · USD 22 application fee. Furnished private house on the grounds with linens, stocked kitchen, wi-fi, laundry and use of a smart car; an electric piano is available. Domestic residents receive a USD 1,000 stipend. International residents receive no stipend and may instead submit up to USD 1,000 of expenses for reimbursement. Residents pay for their own meals and their own travel to Bainbridge Island. There is no dedicated studio; residents work in the house.
  • Borealis Philanthropy: Just Futures Initiative Grant 2026
    https://borealisphilanthropy.org/news-and-views/just-futures-initiative-grant-opportunity/
    Borealis Philanthropy · deadline Rolling / undated · 12-month general operating grants. Standard grants $50,000 to $100,000; strategic collaborative grants up to $200,000 with strong justification; most awards fall in the $50,000 to $75,000 range. Requests should generally not exceed 30% of an organization's committed annual budget. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
